name: sawbuck
description: Sawbuck for Claude Code: re-prove each win from source edits, in one install.

plugins.name: sawbuck-reins
plugins.description: One install wires the sawbuck guide band (watching / N caught / last verdict / steer rate) plus five slash commands: /sawbuck-reins:contract (sign the repo and check every turn), /sawbuck-reins:check (verify now), /sawbuck-reins:audit (rules that pull against each other), /sawbuck-reins:rules (the rules you keep enforcing), /sawbuck-reins:shape (what you push on). The mod runs no program; the commands run the pinned sawbuck CLI through Claude's own Bash tool.
